credits_text: Directed by Michael Curtiz (Warner Bros. Pictures). Starring John Barrymore, Marian Marsh, Chas. Butterworth, Donald Cook. Based on the play by Martin Brown, adapted by Charles Alexander and Raemy Thom.
description: A vintage movie poster features a man in a suit and hat holding a gun, with a woman in a revealing outfit leaning against him. The title "The Mad Genius" is prominently displayed.
